question: I think I'm lost on a trail in the woods and it's getting dark. What should I do?
I don't have a map or a compass, just my phone with no signal.
My phone is at 15 percent. Should I keep using it or save it?
My snowmobile won't start this morning. It was fine yesterday.
It's electric start and it cranks fine, it just won't catch.
There's fresh gas in it and the kill switch is up. What next?
My MSR Whisperlite won't light. I pump it and nothing comes out at the burner.
I already cleaned the jet with the shaker needle and it's still not working.
The pump plunger feels loose and doesn't build pressure.
I spilled boiling water on my hand making dinner at camp. It's red and blistering.
I don't have any burn gel or aloe. Just a first aid kit with gauze and tape.
Should I pop the blisters? They're about the size of a quarter.
Is it safe to drink from this creek if it looks clear?
My filter cracked when it froze last night. I have a pot and a stove though.
I'm at about 9,000 feet. Does that change how long I boil it?
My friend fell in a creek, he's soaked and shivering hard and it's 35 degrees.
He's stopped shivering and he's slurring his words now.
My truck won't start, it just clicks. I'm at a trailhead an hour from town.
There's nobody else here, so no jump start. I don't have a jump pack either.
How should I store food overnight in grizzly country?
There are no trees big enough to hang a bag and I didn't bring a canister.
Thunder is getting closer and I'm on an exposed ridge above treeline.
I can't get below treeline for at least 30 minutes. What do I do right now?
Can you check whether the storm is going to clear up this afternoon?
I rolled my ankle on a rock 5 miles from the car. It's swollen but I can put some weight on it.
I don't have an elastic bandage. What can I use to wrap it?
My handheld Baofeng isn't picking anything up on the repeater I programmed.
The frequency is right, I double checked it against the repeater book.
The outboard on my jon boat keeps dying when I give it throttle.
I already squeezed the primer bulb until it's firm and the tank vent is open.
The power's out from the storm. Where can I run my generator?
It's pouring rain. Can I run it in the open garage just until it stops?
My dog just got a face full of porcupine quills on a hike.
I don't have pliers or a multitool with me. We're 3 miles from the car.
Everything's wet. How do I get a fire going?
I've got a lighter but no fire starters or cotton balls.
